headline: Congress lights out for a Monday with pro forma sessions and committee silence, but 30 new bills hit the House floor on tap.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly at 4:00 p.m. for a pro forma session, conducting minimal formal business before adjourning. No substantive floor action occurred.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for just three minutes, from 4:30 p.m. to 4:33 p.m., in a brief pro forma session with no votes recorded. Speaker Thompson (PA) was appointed as Speaker pro tempore, and 30 new bills plus 11 resolutions were introduced.
